## Precipitation nowcasting code

The code accompanying *Coupling strategies for precipitation nowcasting in China* is available on GitHub.

[Suitable-coupling-for-PN](https://github.com/kiwiyolo/Suitable-coupling-for-PN)

For the scientific context, see the [paper](https://doi.org/10.1080/02626667.2025.2587687). Follow the repository's documentation and licence when using the code.
